description: This file defines the ObjectIPC interface used for encoding and decoding objects for transmission over sockets using JSON as the serialization format. It declares two methods: toJSON() and fromJSON(JSONObject).

classes.name: ObjectIPC
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for encoding an object into JSON and decoding it from JSON for inter-process communication.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Encodes the object into a JSONObject for transmission.

methods.name: fromJSON
methods.description: Decodes the object from a JSONObject received over a socket.
